questions.question: Which is the smallest planet in our solar system?
questions.fact: Mercury is only a little bigger than our Moon.

questions.question: How many minutes are there in a day?
questions.fact: That is 86,400 seconds, every single day.

questions.question: Which gas do plants take in from the air?
questions.fact: In return they give off the oxygen we breathe.

questions.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
questions.fact: The painting is surprisingly small: about 77 by 53 cm.

questions.question: Which animal is the fastest on land?
questions.fact: A cheetah can sprint at around 100 km/h, but only for a short stretch.

questions.question: How many players does a football team have on the pitch?
questions.fact: That includes the goalkeeper, the only one allowed to handle the ball.

questions.question: Bananas are berries.
questions.fact: Botanically yes, while strawberries are not.

questions.question: You can see the Great Wall of China from the Moon with the naked eye.
questions.fact: It is far too narrow. Astronauts cannot even pick it out easily from low orbit.

questions.question: Honey can stay edible for thousands of years.
questions.fact: Pots of honey were found in ancient Egyptian tombs.

questions.question: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
questions.fact: Tall towers are hit many times every year.

questions.question: Octopuses have blue blood.
questions.fact: Their blood carries oxygen with copper instead of iron.

questions.question: Humans only use 10% of their brain.
questions.fact: Brain scans show activity almost everywhere over a day.

questions.question: How many countries are members of the United Nations?
In which year were the first modern Olympic Games held?
questions.fact: They were held in Athens.

questions.question: How high is Mount Everest, in metres?
How many squares are there on a chessboard?
What is 7 × 8?
Which colour is on the outside of a rainbow?
Which is the largest planet?
Which shape has three sides?
What do bees make?
How many hours are there in a week?
Which country has the most inhabitants?
questions.fact: India passed China in 2023.

questions.question: Which river flows through Paris?
questions.fact: More than 30 bridges cross the Seine in Paris.

questions.question: In which country is Machu Picchu?
questions.fact: The old Inca city lies about 2,400 metres above sea level.

questions.question: Which is the longest river in Africa?
questions.fact: The Nile flows through 11 countries.

questions.question: Which country is shaped like a boot?
questions.fact: The toe of the boot almost touches Sicily.

questions.question: What is the currency of Japan?
questions.fact: Yen means "round" or "circle" in Japanese.

questions.question: What is the hardest natural material on Earth?
questions.fact: A diamond is pure carbon, the same element as the lead in a pencil.
